summary.en: Tham Pla Temple in Chiang Rai is an ancient temple featuring natural caves, clear streams with massive cave fish, and resident wild monkeys roaming the temple grounds.
summary.zh: 清莱府鱼洞寺（Tham Pla）是一座历史悠久的古寺，拥有天然溶洞、清澈溪流以及大量体型巨大的野生溪鱼，寺庙周边还有成群的野生猴子。

en: Beware of wild monkeys snatching items and do not provoke them
